title: Provide CodeGraph indexes in disposable lane worktrees
body: The required CodeGraph queries in the VIXEN and KFR noderename worktrees returned that no .codegraph index exists and instructed agents not to initialize one. I had to finish the callback inventory with rg. Add an owner-maintained index/bootstrap path for worker-created worktrees so CodeGraph-first review is usable without an agent initializing project state.

title: Default the VIXEN FetchContent cache to the worktree-local build tree
body: The command nice -n 10 cmake --preset vixen-wsl -DVIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG=/home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json exited 0 but used the host shared cache at ~/.cache/vixen-fetchcontent-cache. To meet this lane's worktree-local requirement I reran it with VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/noderename/build/noderename-fetchcontent. Default isolated presets to their local build tree or expose that as a first-class configure option.

title: Add an offscreen Linux runner for main HUD capture tests
body: The fresh VIXEN HUD capture command exited 255 at WindowNode because DISPLAY is unset. The three HUD file tests require PNGs produced by the Windows-only main_hud_capture.bat, and the main app has no offscreen path like the editor does. Add a Linux offscreen capture route so the three tests can run in headless workers.

title: Align the Vulkan glslang probe diagnostic with configure outcome
body: VIXEN and nested KFR configure both printed Fatal Error: glslang directory not found while CMake returned 0 and the fresh builds succeeded. Resolve the optional SDK path or report a non-fatal severity when configuration continues, so the diagnostic does not look like a required baseline failure.

title: Allow KFR witnesses to use a committed local VIXEN provider without copying source
body: KFR's tracked vixen.pin names 903949c71d4f6a72b485f5a44b7ea607c2fd0995, while this lane's committed provider is b684a03bb8b3f6e6dc646d1c4bbe97b99d682ea6. The exact-pin VIXEN_ROOT check rejected that mismatch, so I copied the KFR source into .tmp/noderename-source and updated only its copied pin. Add a transient local provider revision input that preserves the exact-pin check without a source overlay.

title: Reuse provisioned Vulkan SDKs across KFR scratch build trees
body: The fresh KFR configure downloaded the roughly 320 MB Vulkan SDK into .tmp/noderename-build/vulkan-sdk. Keep the SDK in a reusable user or lane cache so each fresh scratch build does not download and extract another full copy.

title: Reuse staged X11 development packages across KFR scratch build trees
body: The same fresh KFR configure provisioned X11 headers and libraries into .tmp/noderename-build/windowing. Reuse staged packages across scratch build trees while keeping generated files inside authorized worktrees.

title: Provide direct CodegenTool checks without a host ICU environment override
body: The explicitly requested dotnet restore/build/run --check against the pinned CodegenTool~ succeeded only with DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 on this host. CMake's provider build already creates an invariant runtimeconfig and all golden checks pass; expose a documented direct launcher/runtimeconfig so these commands need no manual environment override.
